settings.heading: Fragrance as a practice.
settings.body: We started Aura & Oak in a converted garage in Portland with one candle — Amber & Oakmoss — and a belief that the things we smell every day should be made with as much care as the things we eat and the things we read. Seven years later, we're still a small studio, still pouring by hand, still obsessed with the way a scent can make a room feel like home.
